## Spec

DNSZoneSpec defines the desired state of a zone.

Validation: fallback is only supported for primary zones (`!has(self.fallback) || self.type == 'primary'`)
Validation: secondary zones require secondary configuration (`self.type != 'secondary' || has(self.secondary)`)

## Status

DNSZoneStatus is the observed state of a zone.

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `status.conditions` | `[]Condition` | List type: `map`, keyed by `type` |
| `status.contentHash` | `string` | ContentHash is the sha256 of the canonical RRsets. |
| `status.nameserverAddresses` | `[]string` |  |
| `status.observedGeneration` | `integer` | Format: `int64` |
| `status.published` | `[]object` |  |
| `status.published[].conflicts` | `integer` |  |
| `status.published[].drift` | `integer` |  |
| `status.published[].integration` | `string` | **Required.** |
| `status.published[].lastSyncTime` | `string` | Format: `date-time` |
| `status.published[].managed` | `integer` |  |
| `status.recordCount` | `integer` |  |
| `status.serial` | `integer` | Serial is stamped by the leader as max(prev+1, unix\_now) whenever ContentHash changes for primary zones. Secondary serials and counts belong to each replica's transferred data, not this shared status.<br>Format: `int32` |

## Example

`deploy/kustomize/samples/kudurru.io_v1alpha1_dnszone.yaml`:

```yaml
apiVersion: kudurru.io/v1alpha1
kind: DNSZone
metadata:
  name: home-example-com
spec:
  zoneName: home.example.com.
  type: primary
  soa:
    mname: ns1.home.example.com.
    rname: hostmaster.example.com.
    refresh: 3600
    retry: 900
    expire: 1209600
    minimum: 300
  nameservers: [ns1.home.example.com., ns2.home.example.com.]
  policy:
    queryAccess: allow
    zoneTransfer: useNetworkACL
    transferACL: ["10.0.0.0/8"]
    notify: zoneNameServers
    update: deny
  recordSetSelector:
    namespaces: [dns, apps]
  # v0.2 split-horizon: publish labelled records to a Cloudflare sink.
  # publish:
  #   - integrationRef: { name: cf-public, namespace: dns }
  #     selector: { matchLabels: { kudurru.io/publish: cloudflare } }
  #     types: [A, AAAA, CNAME, TXT, MX, SRV, CAA]
  #     policy: sync
```
